kits.name: glass
kits.prompt: Six separate single taps on a thin crystal wine glass with a small felt mallet: one clear, delicate bell-like ting per tap, every tap followed by one full second of silence. Close-miked, dry studio recording, no room echo, no music, no voices.

kits.name: felt
kits.prompt: Six separate soft thumps of a felt-covered mallet on a thick oak table top: short, round, warm and muted, every thump followed by one full second of silence. Close-miked, dry studio recording, no music, no voices.

kits.name: wood
kits.prompt: Six separate hollow knocks on a small wooden block struck with a wooden stick: short, woody and bright, every knock followed by one full second of silence. Close-miked, dry studio recording, no music, no voices.

kits.name: click
kits.prompt: Six separate satisfying clicks of a premium aluminium laptop trackpad and a soft mechanical latch closing: short, crisp and precise, every click followed by one full second of silence. Close-miked, dry studio recording, no music, no voices.

kits.name: marimba
kits.prompt: Six separate single soft notes on a rosewood marimba played with soft yarn mallets, the same middle note every time: warm, round and short, every note followed by one full second of silence. Dry studio recording, no music, no voices.

kits.name: typing
kits.prompt: Close-miked typing on a quiet premium low-profile laptop keyboard: a short burst of confident fast typing, about fifteen soft keystrokes and one spacebar, ending with a single firm Enter key press. Dry studio recording, no room echo, no voices, no music.

kits.name: sub
kits.prompt: Three separate deep, soft sub-bass impacts: a low round felt-like thud with a short natural tail, no crack, no whoosh, no rise, every impact followed by two full seconds of silence. Clean studio recording, no music, no voices.

kits.name: air
kits.prompt: One soft natural breath of air moving past, rising gently and fading away over three seconds, clearly audible, airy and calm, no whoosh, no music, no voices.

kits.name: grow
kits.prompt: Delicate close-miked rustle and soft crackle of a young green plant stem and leaves unfurling and growing, organic and quiet but clearly audible, three seconds, no music, no voices.

kits.name: sting
kits.prompt: A single warm felt piano note with a soft glassy harmonic ringing above it, played once and left to decay naturally for four seconds, intimate and close-miked, no other notes, no music bed, no voices.
